response.sql: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name as race_name, SUM(res.points) as total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps as REAL)) as avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), avg_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points FROM race_totals) SELECT SUM(rt.total_points) as combined_total_points, AVG(rt.avg_laps) as average_laps_completed, AVG(rt.total_points - at.avg_total_points) as average_excess FROM race_totals rt CROSS JOIN avg_total at WHERE rt.total_points > at.avg_total_points
